title: Layer configurable quality guardrails
rationale: Keep turn-cap and velocity-governor protections enabled by default, but expose thresholds through layered defaults, user/workspace JSON, environment overrides, and the /little-coder UI. Environment variables remain highest precedence; TUI edits persist to workspace settings and apply immediately.

description: Velocity governor sent a model-facing steer message from turn_start while active cooldown continued to throttle; each queued message started another model turn, creating a ping-pong loop.
resolution: On governor throttle, show the warning via UI notification and abort the turn. Never enqueue a steer/follow-up model message from the turn_start hook. Regression test confirms no sendUserMessage calls during cooldown.
